labels.justification: The clause allows data deletion upon request, aligning with data erasure requirements.
The clause informs users of data processing purposes, matching the notice requirement for consent.
The clause allows users to control data sharing, aligning with purpose-specific processing.
The clause allows users to adjust data processing purposes, matching lawful purpose requirements.
The clause allows users to withdraw consent, matching the withdrawal notice requirement.
The clause allows users to access their data, matching the data principal rights requirement.
